work: Cini et al., (Inner-Product) Functional Encryption with Updatable Ciphertexts
positioning_note: Defines CUFE and explicitly restricts ciphertexts to one update; CAMH-CUFE must solve repeated-update composability rather than simply loop Update.

work: Arriaga, Iovino and Tang, Updatable Functional Encryption
functional_encryption_or_functional_acce: functional programs over mutable encrypted memory
positioning_note: Repeated updates in functional encryption already exist in a different UFE/RAM-program model; CAMH-CUFE cannot claim first multi-update FE and must distinguish CUFE tag/state semantics and path auditability.

work: Ananth, Cohen and Jain, Cryptography with Updates
positioning_note: Generic cryptographic update transformations predate CAMH-CUFE; novelty must lie beyond generic updatability.

work: Schädlich, Scheu-Hachtel, Tairi and Wang, Ciphertext-Updatable Attribute-Based and Predicate Encryption from Lattices
positioning_note: Provides multi-hop and unbounded-token ciphertext-updatable ABE/PE for bounded-depth circuits. CAMH-CUFE cannot claim first multi-hop ciphertext-updatable fine-grained encryption; it must establish FE output semantics, functional-key non-transferability, CUFE sequential composability, and path-aware audit/certification.

work: Chandran et al., Re-encryption, Functional Re-encryption, and Multi-hop Re-encryption
positioning_note: Shows multi-hop re-encryption and functional re-encryption predate CAMH-CUFE; novelty cannot be generic multi-hop re-encryption.

work: Liang et al., DFA-based Functional Proxy Re-Encryption
positioning_note: Functional proxy re-encryption transforms ciphertexts associated with access strings; distinguish from FE function-output semantics and auditable state histories.

work: Yao et al., Identity-Based PRE with Single-Hop Conditional Delegation and Multi-Hop Ciphertext Evolution
positioning_note: Multi-hop ciphertext evolution is already established terminology; CAMH-CUFE must not claim this concept generically.

work: Levy-dit-Vehel and Romeas, Interactivity in Constructive Cryptography
positioning_note: Provides composable treatment of updatable encryption and leakage-sensitive guarantees; constrains use of the word composable in CAMH-CUFE.

work: Cai et al., Verifiable and Fair Registered Attribute-Based Multi-Hop PRE for LLM Agents
positioning_note: Closest recent multi-hop+verifiability neighbor; CAMH-CUFE must differentiate FE semantics, sequential CUFE composability, replayable authenticated history, and checkpoint trust semantics.

work: Liang et al., Pairing-Free Certificate-Based PRE for Secure Data Sharing in Public Clouds
positioning_note: Establishes longstanding FGCS acceptance of formally analyzed PRE for cloud data sharing.

work: Eltayieb et al., Certificateless PRE with Cryptographic Reverse Firewalls
positioning_note: Recent FGCS cryptographic data-sharing construction with security analysis and efficiency evaluation; useful methodological comparator.

work: Zhou et al., PCL-BPRE
positioning_note: Recent FGCS PRE paper combines formal CCA proof and experimental evaluation in cloud-based IIoT; CAMH-CUFE must exceed a local toy evaluation.

work: Xu et al., Forward-Secure Multi-User and Verifiable Dynamic Searchable Encryption
positioning_note: Uses a multiset-hash state chain for forward privacy and verifiable encrypted-data updates; key conceptual neighbor for state chaining but not FE or CUFE composability.

work: Blockchain-assisted Verifiable Certificate-Based Searchable Encryption
positioning_note: FGCS paper explicitly refines verifiability into levels; supports careful separation of verification semantics in CAMH-CUFE.

work: Verifiable Multi-Client Blockchain-Based Dynamic Data Retrieval
positioning_note: Combines public verifiability, dynamic encrypted data and updatable encryption for revocation; useful closest systems-level comparator.

work: A Verifiable Data Integrity Scheme for Distributed Data Sharing in Fog Computing
positioning_note: Demonstrates FGCS interest in distributed public verification and dynamic operations without a trusted third-party auditor.

work: Efficient Verifiable Databases with Insertion and Deletion
positioning_note: Addresses update attacks and public verification for dynamic outsourced state; compare only at the audit/state-integrity layer.

work: Full Integrity and Freshness for Cloud Data
positioning_note: Explicitly targets replay resistance/freshness in cloud data; relevant to CAMH-CUFE replay/rollback threat discussion.

work: Privacy Preserving Cloud Data Auditing with Efficient Key Update
positioning_note: Formalizes auditing with key updates and implements it; relevant to audit/update methodology, not FE semantics.

work: Deng et al., Non-interactive and Privacy-Preserving Neural Network Learning Using Functional Encryption
positioning_note: Confirms FGCS publishes FE-based distributed/privacy-preserving systems when formal security and measured utility are both present.

work: Towards Leakage-Resilient Fine-Grained Access Control in Fog Computing
positioning_note: FGCS precedent for a generic functional-encryption framework motivated by fog access control.

work: PSCD: Privacy-Preserving Framework for DNNs on Encrypted Distributed Datasets
positioning_note: Very recent FGCS FE application reinforces the need to connect CAMH-CUFE to a distributed-system problem, not present it as isolated cryptographic machinery.

work: Timed-Release and Partially Private Access Control for Decentralized IoT Collaboration Systems
positioning_note: Recent FGCS work uses FE in decentralized collaboration; useful for motivating state/time-aware encrypted access control.

work: Blockchain-Enabled Reliable Outsourced Decryption CP-ABE Using Responsive zkSNARK
positioning_note: Shows current FGCS bar for verifiable cryptographic systems: formal mechanism plus implementation and end-to-end performance evidence.
